channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: With nine kids, Abby and Wayne are looking for a home where their bustling family can truly thrive; their search takes them from a log-inspired estate on 100 acres to a modern retreat with a private community beach, and finally to a multi-level canal home designed for gathering and fun; can they find the perfect match for their lively crew?
